description: This source file provides functions for parsing Markdown content into segments, filtering them, and applying translations, utilizing the goldmark Markdown parser library.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Extracts translatable segments from Markdown content, identifying paragraph, heading, and list item blocks, and generating segment IDs based on content hash.

methods.name: blockParent
methods.description: Finds the parent block element that is translatable (paragraph, heading, list item) for a given AST node.

methods.name: isTranslatableBlock
methods.description: Determines if an AST node is a translatable block element (paragraph, heading, or list item).

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Replaces segments in the original body text with their translated counterparts.
